_doc: The restaurant «Янтарь» (docs/restaurant.md). Where it stands is the city plan's plot (Content/City/city_plan.json plots[id=plot]: map, yaw, ground); podium = the floor over that ground (m). Hours are used while no waiter of the town life is on shift (open from..to, game hours). Waits: each dish's cook seconds (menu.json) times wait_scale. standin: the waiter (mesh) and the cook (cook_mesh) drawn by the restaurant itself before the town life's staff exist (a model of /Game/Characters/Humans; its name from the strings).

kitchen_door._doc: the fishing's kitchen yantar (Content/Fishing/fishing.json kitchens): the same point (cm from the plot's ue), radius and hours; the cook comes to the back door while the hero is there
